column1: # CAP-15B: the mORMot define set, DERIVED from the pinned
# deps/mormot2/src/mormot.defines.inc and committed so the sweep can run
# in a job that has no deps/ tree. It is DATA, never a hand-written list:
# test/cap7f/check_mormot_defines.ps1 re-derives and refuses a mismatch
# wherever the pin is present, and section C12 of
# test/cap15b/check_cap15b_contracts.ps1 requires that on every platform
# leg - so a mORMot repin that adds or removes a define turns four legs
# red until this file is regenerated in the same commit.
